notes: The full-time MBA class profile page and the full-time MBA tuition page under case.edu/weatherhead/academics/graduate/mba/full-time-mba/ return HTTP 403 from this network, so no class profile figures could be verified. Salary: the school publishes only an average (90,640 average base salary, Class of 2023, same placement page), no median, so salary_median_usd is null. 2023 is the most recent placement year listed (2021 to 2023). The current Weatherhead MBA admissions page describes a flexible evening format and quotes a part-time MBA total program tuition of 69,762 for students entering fall 2026 at 1,661 per credit hour over 42 credit hours; the traditional full-time class profile appears to no longer be published. Verified pages: CWRU SFS tuition page also lists 2026-27 continuing full-time MBA at the same 1,661 per credit rate.
